Anime for beginners: the version of your favorite show you have not watched yet.

Breaking Bad fans start with Death Note, Money Heist fans get Great Pretender, and The Boys fans go straight to Chainsaw Man. Bonus for Dexter fans: Monster, a psychological thriller you cannot stop watching.
